content.thinking:
I'm noticing the terms say EXW, yet the text also says freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by the seller and added to the invoice, which contradicts EXW and looks more like a DDP or CIP arrangement, so I'm flagging that. For the structured output, I'm reading the quantity as 8,500 using English number convention, so 8500, and I'm placing it in the quantity-confirmed field along with the confirmed date of 2025-11-26 and the unit price of 6.11 USD.

I'm also tentatively treating the order date, 2025-10-29, as the date_ordered value, and since no document date is stated anywhere, I'm leaving that field empty.

verdict.summary_en: Order acknowledgement OA25329115 from Boise Semiconductor Inc. to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318570 dated 2025-10-29. It has one line: item 00010, CMP-GAM-002 Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5, quantity 8,500 at 6.11 USD, confirmed for 2025-11-26. Terms are EXW Boise with payment NET30. The delivery terms contradict themselves.
red_flags: The delivery terms contradict each other. They state EXW Boise and say DDP is not agreed. They also say freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by the Seller and added to the invoice. Under EXW the buyer normally arranges and pays for these, so the extra charges on the invoice need clarifying.
The document shows no total value and no document date. The unit price is 6.11 USD with no stated price unit, such as per piece.
observations: Clean typed PDF with no handwriting, stamps, signatures or visible corrections.
Single page and single line item. The description wraps over three lines.
The quantity 8,500 is read as eight thousand five hundred, using the English convention.
